What are the ingredients of Thai curry?
What's the secret to an authentic Thai green curry?
What gives Thai green curry its flavour?

items.markdown:
Thai green curry requires `green curry paste, coconut milk, and fresh protein and vegetables`.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/green-curry-new-2/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/green-curry-new-2/)

Curry Paste Ingredients

- **Green chilies:** Fresh green spur or bird's eye chilies for heat and color.
- **Aromatics:** Lemongrass, galangal (or ginger), garlic, and shallots.
- **Herbs and spices:** Fresh coriander (cilantro) roots/leaves, kaffir lime (makrut) lime zest or leaves, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, and white peppercorns.
- **Umami:** Thai shrimp paste (gapi) or a vegetarian alternative like miso paste.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/green-curry-new-2/) [[1]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/thai-green-chicken-curry-0)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DGhlWf2zJAh/?hl=en)[[3]](https://www.lazycatkitchen.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/)[[4]](https://fanclubthailand.co.uk/thai-food-recipes-gaeng-khiao-wan-gai-green-curry-with-chicken/)

Curry Sauce and Body Ingredients

- **Coconut milk:** Full-fat coconut milk (about 400ml / 14 oz).
- **Liquids:** Water or unsalted chicken stock.
- **Seasoning:** Thai fish sauce and palm sugar (or brown sugar).
- **Aromatic leaves:** Torn makrut (kaffir) lime leaves.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/green-curry-new-2/) [[1]](https://www.lazycatkitchen.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/)[[2]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-green-curry-recipe/)[[3]](https://rosasthai.com/recipes/rosas-green-curry-chicken)[[4]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/food/recipes/thaigreencurry_67788)

Proteins and Vegetables

- **Protein:** Sliced chicken thighs or breast (around 450g to 500g), or tofu/vegetables for a vegetarian option.
- **Vegetables:** Thai eggplants, pea aubergines, sliced bamboo shoots, and red spur chilies for color.
- **Garnish:** Fresh Thai sweet basil leaves.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/green-curry-new-2/) [[1]](https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/thai-green-chicken-curry)[[2]](https://www.jamieoliver.com/recipes/butternut-squash/thai-green-curry/)

expanded_element.title: What makes a Thai Green Curry feel rich and refreshing at the same time ...
expanded_element.description: Makrut lime leaves are full of intensely fragrant oils, which give the curry its bright, almost floral citrus note that contrasts the rich coconut cream. Then there's Thai fish sauce, known as nam pla. It's made by slowly fermenting anchovies and salt and just a few drops add a deep umami flavour.
